description: This is a unit test file for the 'jjwg_Markers' class, which tests various methods and properties related to map markers in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: jjwg_MarkersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'jjwg_Markers' class functionalities.

methods.name: testjjwg_Markers
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and basic properties of the 'jjwg_Markers' bean.

methods.name: testconfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that the 'configuration' method correctly initializes associated 'jjwg_Maps' object and settings array.

methods.name: testdefine_loc
methods.description: Verifies the 'define_loc' method returns default values when no attributes are preset, and echoes back preset attributes.

methods.name: testis_valid_lng
methods.description: Validates longitude values for correctness, ensuring only -180 to 180 are accepted.

methods.name: testis_valid_lat
methods.description: Validates latitude values for correctness, ensuring only -90 to 90 are accepted.
